content:
Maya: Quick sync — final pass on the econ battlecard we want to use for the launch post + webinar. Primary opponents: big cloud AI platforms + LLM API vendors + infra runtimes. Need 3 crisp soundbites and one routing rule for inbound leads.
Sam: Can we prioritize: latency/cost delta, predictable SLAs (Dedicated), and the unified dev UX? those map to customer objections we saw last week.
Aj: Agree. Also add a short line on fallback/resilience — how we gracefully degrade to cheaper variants. Sales needs a 1-liner to handle procurement (pricing predictability).
Lina: I can draft 3 soundbites by EOD. Want tone: confident, not combative. Examples: "Keep inference predictable, not surprising" or "Control your cost per token — not the other way around." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maya: Love the tone. Add one that contrasts rollout/rollbacks: "Ship without fear: canary + auto-fallback built-in."
Sam: For benchmarks, use a single chart/metric in the battlecard: median p99 latency vs tokens/sec and cost per 1M tokens. Keep footnote: quantization/seq len assumptions.
Aj: For inbound routing: rule idea — if prospect tags "enterprise" or mentions "SLA"/"VPC" route to Enterprise AE; if "prototype" or "MVP" route to self-serve SDR. Also route any "latency" or "cost" threads to Solutions Eng.
Lina: Drafting the copy. Will include 3 variations: social lead, webinar headline, and sales 1-liner. Example social: "Benchmarked latency that scales — see how we compare to cloud endpoints. Webinar Wed 10am"
ops-bot: Document created: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/econ-brief-1788887777 (ops tag: marketing/battlecards)
Maya: Nice. For the battlecard body we need: top claims, supporting proof (bench data), rebuttals, routing hooks, FAQ snippet. Keep each section 1–2 bullets.
Sam: Rebuttals suggestion:
```
Claim: "Lower latency at scale"
Counter: "Clouds have more infra"
Rebuttal: "We optimize runtime & routing; for the same budget you get higher effective throughput and predictable tail latency."
```
Aj: Can we add a procurement soundbite: "Reserved capacity with predictable unit economics — commit and smooth costs across quarters"
Lina: Working on the 3 soundbites + 2-line rebuttals now. Will ping when ready. :memo:
Maya: Timeline: Lina posts drafts here by 5pm PT, Sam finalizes benchmark chart, Aj confirms the routing verbs for SFDC by EOD. Ops: link the final doc to the webinar invite once live.
Aj: I'll sync with SDR lead re: SFDC fields (enterprise/prototype/latency/cost).
Lina: Drafts uploading in 10.
Maya: Perfect — thanks team. We'll run a quick pre-webinar roleplay on Tue. :rocket:
